blocks.explanation:
Yahan do barabariyan (equalities) ek saath saabit karni hain: product pehli expression ke barabar bhi hai aur doosri ke bhi.
Product ko kholenge, phir \(\sin^2 + \cos^2 = 1\) ko do mukhtalif tareeqon se lagayenge.
Plan: expand, difference of squares, phir badalna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: ek statement.
Saabit karna hai: \(\cos(\alpha + \beta)\cos(\alpha - \beta) = \cos^2\alpha - \sin^2\beta\) aur yeh \(\cos^2\beta - \sin^2\alpha\) ke bhi barabar hai.
Tareeqa: \(\cos(\alpha \pm \beta)\) ke formulas, \((x - y)(x + y) = x^2 - y^2\), aur \(\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x = 1\). Do natije chahiye, is liye aakhri qadam do dafa alag alag karenge.

Dono factors kholein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = (\cos\alpha\cos\beta - \sin\alpha\sin\beta)\]
\[\times(\cos\alpha\cos\beta + \sin\alpha\sin\beta)\]
Kyun: Sum wale cosine mein minus aur difference wale mein plus aata hai.

Difference of squares lagayein
\[= \cos^2\alpha\cos^2\beta - \sin^2\alpha\sin^2\beta\]
Kyun: Dono brackets mein wahi do cheezein hain, sirf beech ka sign mukhtalif hai: \((x - y)(x + y) = x^2 - y^2\), jahan \(x = \cos\alpha\cos\beta\) aur \(y = \sin\alpha\sin\beta\). Is se chaar terms ki bajaye seedhe do terms aate hain.

Pehli shakal: \(\cos^2\beta\) aur \(\sin^2\alpha\) badlein
\[= \cos^2\alpha(1 - \sin^2\beta) - (1 - \cos^2\alpha)\sin^2\beta\]
\[= \cos^2\alpha - \cos^2\alpha\sin^2\beta\]
\[- \sin^2\beta + \cos^2\alpha\sin^2\beta\]
\[= \cos^2\alpha - \sin^2\beta\]
Kyun: Target mein sirf \(\cos^2\alpha\) aur \(\sin^2\beta\) hain, is liye baqi do (\(\cos^2\beta\), \(\sin^2\alpha\)) ko inhi mein badla. Beech wale do mixed terms barabar aur ulte sign ke hain, cancel ho gaye.

Doosri shakal: \(\cos^2\alpha\) aur \(\sin^2\beta\) badlein
\[= (1 - \sin^2\alpha)\cos^2\beta - \sin^2\alpha(1 - \cos^2\beta)\]
\[= \cos^2\beta - \sin^2\alpha\cos^2\beta\]
\[- \sin^2\alpha + \sin^2\alpha\cos^2\beta\]
\[= \cos^2\beta - \sin^2\alpha\]
Kyun: Qadam 3 wale natije par wapas ja kar is dafa ulta jora badla, kyunke doosre target mein \(\cos^2\beta\) aur \(\sin^2\alpha\) chahiye. Phir se mixed terms cancel.
Dhyan dein: Pehli shakal se doosri par seedha jump na karein; dono ko qadam 3 se alag alag nikalna saaf aur mehfooz hai.

Tasdeeq, \(\alpha = 60^{\circ}\), \(\beta = 30^{\circ}\)
\[\cos 90^{\circ}\cos 30^{\circ} = 0\]
\[\cos^2 60^{\circ} - \sin^2 30^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{4} - \dfrac{1}{4} = 0\]
\[\cos^2 30^{\circ} - \sin^2 60^{\circ} = \dfrac{3}{4} - \dfrac{3}{4} = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Teeno expressions zero aayin, yani teeno barabar hain.
